in_sanskrit.name: Sharvee
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Love
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharvee एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Sharvee is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Shree’, which means prosperity, wealth and good fortune. The suffix ‘Vee’ in Sharvee signifies the goddess of love, Saraswati, who is the goddess of knowledge, arts, wisdom and learning. Thus, Sharvee is a beautiful name that embodies love, grace and prosperity.
